public_rationale: Microsoft's disclosure materially challenges the revenue-growth rhetoric: it attributed 16 percentage points of Azure growth to AI services. But that is a broader service category and a segment measure. It does not settle generative AI's contribution to consolidated growth or establish the asserted losses. The available evidence therefore does not support the compound claim, but the required matching measures are insufficient for a definitive contradiction.
limitations: Revenue growth does not establish profit.
Large capital budgets do not establish operating or net losses.
The unknown loss accounting basis prevents a definitive money assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI services lose big tech companies a lot of money and produce little revenue, so the AI trade drives no meaningful revenue growth.

statement.excerpt: Worse still, these services, while losing these companies massive amounts of money, don't produce much revenue, meaning that the AI trade is not driving any real, meaningful revenue growth.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: losing these companies massive amounts of money
not driving any real, meaningful revenue growth
our_interpretation: The companies are Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta and Tesla, with the surrounding text emphasizing the first four.
The ordinary reading concerns generative AI services' attributable revenue, losses and contribution to company revenue growth.
I use January–March 2025, the latest generally reported quarter before publication.
Meaningful means a material contribution to the companies' growth; I do not invent a numerical cutoff.
Company growth disclosures can test the revenue component, but the claimed losses have no specified accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable generative AI financial evidence shows substantial losses, small revenue and an immaterial contribution to company revenue growth during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes a material generative AI contribution to company revenue growth or disproves the claimed substantial losses. Any conclusion must identify which component is settled.
